title: Bar Salts Lemon & Lime Flavour Concentrate 10ml By Vampire Vape
description: Experience the sharp and clean notes of Lemon Lime with this flavour concentrate from Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts range. This 10ml bottle provides a zesty and refreshing taste, perfect for vapers who appreciate a bright and tangy flavour profile in their DIY e-liquids. The concentrate allows for flexible e-liquid creation, letting you adjust the nicotine strength and VG/PG ratio by adding nicotine shots and a base mix according to your preferences. It’s an excellent choice for crafting a personalized vaping experience with a vibrant citrus kick. Designed for vapers who enjoy crafting their blends, this 100% PG concentrate provides the foundation for a personalized vape experience. Adjust the nicotine level and VG/PG ratios to your liking by adding nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the perfect balance. Mix this concentrate with a VG/PG base of your choice and add nicotine shots as desired to achieve your perfect vape, with recommended dilution rates between 15-20% to suit your taste. Produced in the UK, this high-quality concentrate is designed for optimal flavour accuracy and mixing versatility. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
